subject: WATT.ma public roaming/data surface validation

documented_locations_path.result: HTML/page route, not an anonymously consumable OCPI JSON feed at this URL

documented_tariffs_path.result: HTML/page route, not an anonymously consumable OCPI JSON feed at this URL

api_chargers.interpretation: The public client route exists but currently exposes no anonymous charger inventory. It cannot be used as a 146-station ingestion feed.

public_map_surface.interpretation: The public map visibly renders a Morocco-wide directory, but the validated anonymous JSON endpoints do not expose that inventory. The directory may still be used as secondary HTML/page corroboration, not as a native CPO feed.

modeling.cpo_operator: retain independently validated native CPO; WATT labels are secondary aggregation evidence
modeling.site_brand: may be corroborated station-by-station from public WATT pages without redefining CPO
modeling.app_source_access_network: WATT.ma public map / roaming aggregation when the observation originates there
modeling.tariff_channel: WATT/OCPI aggregation only when an actual tariff value is publicly exposed; never infer direct CPO tariff
modeling.status_source: WATT.ma only for an actually returned public live status; prefer fresh native CPO status

impact.evone: Useful as an independent third-party corroboration surface, but it does not unlock an EVOne national inventory or status feed.
impact.fastvolt: Public pages can corroborate individual FastVolt sites such as Morocco Mall, but /api/chargers cannot supply a national automated inventory.
impact.totalenergies: Public pages can corroborate host/site presence without resolving CPO or Club EV-Charge native status provenance.
impact.shell_vivo: Operator pages can strengthen site-level Shell/Vivo inventory evidence, but remain aggregation evidence rather than a native technical CPO feed.

next_step: Use public server-rendered WATT station/operator pages only for station-specific secondary reconciliation; do not promote WATT to a production inventory/status source unless a non-empty public GET data contract is independently validated.
